history.period: Ancient; popular tradition claims ~3000 years (unverified — flag)
history.summary: One of the most famous Hanuman temples of Kerala, a kavu (sacred grove) shrine at Alathiyur, Poilissery, about 6 km from Tirur on the Tirur–Ponnani road. The sanctum enshrines Hanuman with Rama, Lakshmana, Ganapathy and Ayyappa idols; it is the Rama–Hanuman pairing that draws devotees. Key vazhipadus include Avil Nivedyam/Kuzhacha Avil, Vadamala (butter garland) and Gadha Pooja; belief holds that three pradakshinams remove bad luck. The widely repeated '3000 years old' claim has no documented evidence — flag as oral tradition. CSV town/state (Malappuram, Kerala) are correct; nearest hub town is Tirur.
